input.question: When was the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary built?

documents.text: Region Sicily Rite Catholic Patron Our Lady of the Rosary Location Location Alcamo , province of Trapani , Italy Municipality Alcamo State Italy Territory Alcamo Geographic coordinates 37°58′55″N 12°57′51″E ﻿ / ﻿ 37.98187°N 12.96419°E ﻿ / 37.98187 ; 12.96419 Architecture Funded by Dominican friars Groundbreaking 1660 Santa Maria del Rosario ( `` Our Lady of the Rosary '' , also called San Domenico ) is a Catholic church in Alcamo , in the province of Trapani . History [ edit ] It was founded in 1660 with the adjoining friary ( used for public offices and houses after 1866 )
